records.scope: Entire javap display read in contiguous spans1-350,351-700,701-1030; static analysis only.
records.observation: Constructors initialize keys/types/methods null, new CategorySummary, usedfalse/visibletrue/searchabletrue; full constructor stores provided name/topology/color/width without validation, shorter leaves topology/color null. Mutable setters/getters expose references, arrays and summary; visiblySearchable is conjunction. setInfoKeys(String) null clears both arrays, EMPTY string leaves old arrays unchanged because token count0 skips assignments. Tokenizer preserves percent delimiters; percent consumes next token, first char becomes InfoType, remainder appended as literal key; other tokens literal. Trailing percent throws NoSuchElementException, escaped percent not handled specially (can become InfoType percent), width/precision/multi-character printf specifiers not parsed. No automatic leading empty literal before leading specifier; parsed keys/types independently allocated, no shape validation. Array setters retain references, setMethodIDs converts positive-length int array to Method instances else null. Writer order index int, mixed name, topology int, ColorAlpha5, width byte, signed-short cast counts plus ALL keys/types/methods, CategorySummary16. No range checks: width readByte sign-extends, count overflow can disagree with emitted element count. Reader uses NEW Topology(DataInput) and ColorAlpha(DataInput), avoiding ColorAlpha.readObject no-op; readShort counts<=0 set corresponding arrays null and consume no elements, positive counts allocate/read. Existing summary read in place; read does not reset used/visible/searchable, which are not serialized (fresh constructor defaults only). Partial reads mutate fields without rollback. No getByteSize method here. toString reconstructs info display by alternating key/type at equal index up to max lengths, prints methods, flags, summary. isShadowCategory tests any negative index. Shadow factory event-1/state-3 white alpha191, arrow-2 yellow255, width5, Preview_+topology string, supplied topology reference; unsupported returnsnull, null topology throws. Connects converter-created shadow categories and category-map serialization to previously read buffers. No archived execution or independent semantic approval.
